what: لا توصية بلا بدائل: ثلاثة خيارات مختلفة حقًا، أحدها «لا نغير شيئًا» يُقيَّم بجدية. — No recommendation without alternatives: three genuinely different options, one of them 'change nothing', evaluated seriously.
when: strategy, build-vs-buy, pricing, hiring, any important decision
how: Frame first: the decision, who it affects, the outcome wanted, constraints, horizon. Then options A/B/C + do-nothing in a table: cost, benefit, reversibility, time to signal, main risk. Options that are the same idea in three sizes do not count.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-product-strategy (paraphrased in own words)

what: حدّد الافتراضات القليلة التي لو أخطأت لتغيّر القرار، واحسب عتبتها بالكود لا بالتخمين. — Find the few assumptions that would change the decision if wrong, and compute their thresholds in code, not by guesswork.
when: any plan resting on estimates (demand, price, cost, conversion)
how: List the assumptions; for each, solve for the value at which the preferred option stops winning (sympy.solve of profit_A = profit_B, or break-even = 0). Compare the threshold with the evidence. Related run: break-even Q = 6000 and p* = 60 were solved exactly with sympy (proofs/general-data), but no A-vs-B flipping threshold has been computed here yet, so this method is 📄.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-product-strategy (paraphrased in own words); proofs/general-data/make_data.py

what: اعرض احتمال الخسارة والنطاق P5–P95 بدل ربح متوقع واحد. — Show the probability of loss and the P5-P95 range instead of one expected profit.
how: See ANLY Monte Carlo: seeded 100k draws over the uncertain inputs. Proof: P(loss) 0.356, P5 -33,252, P50 10,570, P95 61,457. State the distributions you assumed next to the result.

what: تخيّل أن الخيار المفضل فشل بعد سنة واكتب لماذا، ثم عالج أقوى الأسباب قبل التوصية. — Imagine the favourite option failed a year from now, write why, and address the strongest causes before recommending it.
when: before any recommendation with real cost or low reversibility
how: Write 5-10 failure stories (market, execution, team, tech, legal, timing); score likelihood x impact; turn the top 3 into mitigations or early warning signs; check second-order effects and dependencies.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-product-strategy (paraphrased in own words)

what: لأسئلة الاتجاه الغامضة: اكتب رأيك أولًا ثم اطلب ثلاثة آراء مستقلة بلا سياق المحادثة، واجمعها مع إبراز الخلاف. — For ambiguous direction questions: write my own view first, then ask three independent voices without the conversation history, and merge them with dissent shown.
when: multi-path choices with little guidance (not facts, not code review); sub-agents available
how: Reduce to one question; my position + 3 reasons + main risk BEFORE reading others; voices: architect (long-term correctness), skeptic (challenge the premise), pragmatist (speed, user impact), critic (failure modes); synthesise and keep the dissent visible.

what: سجّل كل قرار مهم في سطر: ما تغير، والدليل، والعلامة (قبول/مراقبة/رفض)، وشرط المراجعة. — Record each important decision as one line: what changed, the evidence, a mark (accept / watch / reject) and a review condition.
when: long projects, repeated trials, anything you may revisit
how: Append JSONL {date, decision, options, evidence, mark, review_if}. Repeating confidence is not approval; default to a dry run for risky moves. Lead every summary with the decision.

what: حوّل التوصية إلى مراحل، لكل مرحلة مقياس ونقطة مراجعة وشرط إيقاف مكتوب مسبقًا. — Turn the recommendation into stages, each with a metric, a checkpoint and a stop condition written in advance.
how: Stage | goal | metric + threshold | date | kill/review rule | owner. Prefer reversible first steps. Kill rules are numeric ('CAC > 2x LTV for 6 weeks -> stop').
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-product-strategy (paraphrased in own words)

what: كل متطلب مرتبط بنتيجة قابلة للقياس وشروط إطلاق وتراجع، وكل معيار قبول له سيناريو وفعل ونتيجة ونفي ووسيلة تحقق. — Every requirement is tied to a measurable outcome with launch and rollback conditions; every acceptance criterion has a scenario, action, expected result, must-not and verification method.
when: writing a PRD, a feature brief, a spec for an agent
how: Quick capture: goal, in/out of scope, assumptions, 3-7 acceptance criteria, blockers. No vague words ('fast' -> 'p95 < 300 ms'). Block only for security, data loss, irreversible migration, API breakage, real cost or destructive actions; otherwise record and proceed. Mark revised criteria [revised].
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-product-strategy (paraphrased in own words); github.com/affaan-m/ECC skills/intent-driven-development (MIT (c) 2026 Affaan Mustafa), paraphrased

what: سبعة أسئلة للمنتج (من؟ الألم بالأرقام؟ لماذا الآن؟ النسخة المثالية؟ الحد الأدنى؟ ما لن نفعله؟ المقياس؟) ثم ترتيب ICE. — Seven product questions (who, pain quantified, why now, 10-star version, MVP, anti-goal, metric), then ICE ranking.
when: idea triage, roadmap ordering, feature requests
how: ICE = impact x confidence / effort, each 1-5; compute and sort in code; show the inputs so people can argue with them, not with the total.

what: احسب أفضل توزيع للموارد المحدودة بين المنتجات بالبرمجة الخطية بدل التقدير. — Compute the best allocation of limited resources across products with linear programming instead of guessing.
when: capacity, budget or time limits shared by several products
how: scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs') (see ANLY LP); for integer quantities use OR-Tools MIP. Proof: max 40x+30y with x+y<=40, 2x+y<=60 gave x=y=20, profit 1,400, cross-checked with sympy.

what: اشتق السعر الذي يعظّم الربح من دالة الطلب، واحسب نقطة التعادل حلًا دقيقًا. — Derive the profit-maximising price from a demand curve and solve the break-even point exactly.
when: pricing questions, unit economics, 'how many must we sell?'
how: profit=(p-c)*(a-b*p); sp.solve(sp.diff(profit,p),p) and check the second derivative is negative; break-even Q = F/(p-v) via sp.solve. Proof: p*=60, profit 16,000; Q=6,000 for F=120,000, p=50, v=30. The demand curve is an assumption; say so.

what: من المعاملة إلى قاعدة الاعتراف إلى قيد متوازن إلى أثره في الدفاتر والقوائم؛ المدين يساوي الدائن دائمًا. — From transaction to recognition rule to a balanced journal entry to its ledger and report impact; debits always equal credits.
how: For each entry: date, accounts, Dr, Cr, rule cited, and the impact on P&L / balance sheet / cash. Assert sum(Dr) == sum(Cr) in code. Standards change, so fetch the current IFRS text (WEB-02) before citing it.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-finance-data (paraphrased in own words)

what: طابق المجاميع من مصدرين مستقلين وفسّر كل فرق؛ لا تضف رقمًا لإخفاء فجوة. — Reconcile totals from two independent sources and explain every difference; never add a number to hide a gap.
when: bank vs ledger, system A vs B, budget vs actual
how: Match on keys (date, amount, reference); list unmatched items on both sides; classify timing vs error vs missing; the residual must be zero or explicitly reported. Same discipline as ANLY control totals.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-finance-data (paraphrased in own words)

what: ابنِ النموذج على محركات طبيعية (عملاء × سعر × احتفاظ) مع فصل الافتراضات عن الحسابات وفحوص توازن تساوي صفرًا. — Build the model on natural drivers (customers x price x retention), with assumptions separated from mechanics and balance checks that equal zero.
how: Inputs sheet (with sources and units) -> drivers -> P&L -> cash -> balance sheet; checks: balance = 0, cash bridge = 0; scenario overrides on the inputs only; recompute in code or with a LibreOffice recalc before quoting; no exact optimum taken from prose.
source: owner: KOSIF SEE v1.7.5 skills/kosif-finance-data (paraphrased in own words)

what: مكتبات لأسعار الأسهم والمؤشرات الفنية وتقارير المحافظ؛ بعضها يعتمد على واجهات غير رسمية. — Libraries for stock prices, technical indicators and portfolio tear-sheets; some rely on unofficial endpoints.
when: quick market exploration (never as an official source)
how: yfinance (scrapes Yahoo, subject to its terms), pandas-ta (beta, no license field on PyPI), quantstats (Apache-2.0). Metadata only; none of them ran here. Prefer official data from exchanges or regulators for anything published.
